label: Finite recombination and prefix closure separate full-law arbitrariness
summary: Issue #1867 upstream test: proposed RecombinationFork derives finite-pattern richness from a nonempty admitted class with same-selector one-step extension, and whole-suffix richness from finite richness plus independent prefix closure. The nonempty eventually-constant histories satisfy one-step/finite richness yet exclude a specifically alternating infinite history; the stable class is closed but not rich, the unrestricted class supplies the positive control, and the empty class isolates nonemptiness. Mathematically the finite-richness-plus-closure step is the standard Cantor-space fact (a closed set dense in a cylinder contains the cylinder); the progress is the application, not new mathematics. Reuses existing Profile/Cell, splice and the stable-groundless control instead of claiming that U entails S. The hand-off from the selector-relative WholeSuffixRich to the downstream #1809 certificate (SuffixComplete/UniversalProjection over a Profile cell) and #1808 internalDiscipline (BothSuccessors over Stance.admits) is supplied by Lean-only, unregistered adapter lemmas in TruthCore/Results/Explanation/NoFoundationLawChaos/Adapters.lean, which also prove that the satisfiers of one fixed Profile form a prefix-closed selector. Note docs/notes/no-foundation-law-chaos.md contains the actual law versus state, Humean best-system, primitive/dispositional law, necessary impersonal/theistic source, and epistemic norm interpretations. Whether naturalism or U undermines epistemic entitlement (the ultimate-ground epistemic-necessity bridge e519065f) was not assessed. An independent semantic challenge on PR #1874 (repair pass 1) found the downstream connection drawn as existing before any adapter existed and an unsupported universal non-entailment claim about naturalism; both were repaired. Successful mathematical construction is not itself philosophical verification.
blocker: The substantive U→N/R/C metaphysical applicability, preservation of governing law/bearer identity, ontic-to-epistemic entitlement, and a sense-checked bridge from the denial of the root-route local existence PSR for contingents (608a262d) to U here all remain OPEN; the adapters connect only the formal hand-off.
